name: Jelemy Dyle
source:
A boy who is lost in the forest. He is a "Kare Shisha" who kills flowers just by touching them.

Due to the way he was treated in the past, he is very wary of others.

[Translated from [url=http://fleur0.starfree.jp/chara.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Flower Emblem: Black lily[/spoiler]
